duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Ocean University of China is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) Degree students need to provide notarized certificate of their highest degree (students applying for master's degree also need to provide the highest degree certificate), notarized documents must be in Chinese or English. If the transcript is in a text other than Chinese or English, a notarized translation in Chinese or English must be attached. 2) Non-degree students are required to provide the highest degree certificate. If the transcript is in a text other than Chinese or English, Chinese or English translation must be attached. 3) If the applicant is a current student, he/she must also submit a study certificate or transfer certificate issued by his/her school. 4) A Chinese or English translation of the resume is required. 5) Applicants with work experience are required to provide proof of work. 6) Applicants for majors requiring language proficiency must submit proof of relevant language proficiency, or proof of completion of high school or university courses in the relevant language. 7) Degree students are required to provide bank deposit proof of not less than one academic year tuition fee

requirements.text: Non-chinese citizen, 16-30 years old, with a high school education, healthy in mind and body
